payload.claim: The comment attributes 'passes `--budget * WRITER_SHARE` in as `cap_usd`' to `SA-0173`, but the spec's own 'The sub-cap' section states it is `SA-0165` that passes `cap_usd` this way, while `SA-0173` only 'holds the same amount back from generation 0' — a different action on `run_stack_batch`'s own budget. The comment cites the wrong spec id for who computes `cap_usd`, which will send a future reader chasing the wrong file.
